text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, for the announcement! Standing at 
the apex this year, the Umamusume of the 
Year is—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: I'm Furioso!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much.
(Clap clap clap clap!)

――The NAU Grand Prix. Furioso was honored 
by the National Association of Umamusume, 
or "NAU", the regional equivalent of the 
URA.

Furioso went on a tear this year, 
achieving the remarkable feat of winning 
six or more Dirt GⅠ races.

There's no way I won't be chosen as the 
regional Horse of the Year now.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Furioso-san, please tell us 
your story.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
It was an undisputed, unanimous selection! 
You must have been in top form this year, 
weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Rather than just being in 
good form—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've developed my own "form" 
that isn't affected by my condition.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Your own form... you say?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Emotions are a double-edged sword, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"If intense emotions cause your core to 
waver... it will lead to inconsistency in 
your results as well. However—"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
If you can fit that intensity into your 
own style, you will be able to win 
consistently.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Staying unwavering and committing fully to 
my own race. I believe the results 
followed because I was able to do just 
that.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: I see~...

Any trace of the precarious young warrior 
was completely gone. Standing there now 
was—

—A truly majestic champion. Even her 
responses exude an unmistakable aura of 
dignity.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Well, we won the NAR Best Umamusume award 
this time, so if we keep this momentum 
going...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Do you think she could even aim for the 
Central Umamusume of the Year next year?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Local Umamusume are eligible as 
well. However, personally speaking—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
There's a prize I want much more than an 
award from Central.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: What is it? Could it be a global award?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: No, I—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I want to win the award I received today 
again. Next year, and for many years to 
come.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I want to be an Umamusume who can always 
lead the regional circuits, and Funabashi, 
from the very front."

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... An unending winning streak. 
That is...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is my goal. And—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I wish to remain an Umamusume who 
continues to be honored on this stage. 
Together with my Trainer, who walks beside 
me as one."
(Clap clap clap clap...)

A confident declaration—followed by 
ceaseless applause. Furioso will likely do 
just as she proclaimed...

I'm sure you will win this award time and 
time again. Reigning forever as the 
champion of the local circuits.
